title: UK Black History Month Selected By...
description:
Every October, UK Black History Month celebrates Black people of African and Caribbean heritage by celebrating the rich tapestry of identities, stories and accomplishments of the Black British community. One of the great pillars of British life is the evolution of Black British music, a transformative force. In celebration of UK Black History Month 2025, dive into this collection of tracks by Black artists, curated exclusively for SoundCloud by production and songwriting duo DAMEDAME*. You can hear their blend of R&B, soul and Afropop on tracks by Jorja Smith, Tems, Wizkid and more.

Visit the SoundCloud Stories blog to learn more about DAMEDAME*: https://soundcloud.com/stories/post/uk-black-history-month-2025-exclusive-playlists
